validation.series_apply: patch --fuzz=0 of series (0001-0014) onto the v7.4-rc4 archive: 14 applied; series then series-apple: 16 applied. The generic result differs from the 7.4_rc4 yume-sources tree only in drivers/clk/rockchip/clk-rk3399.c, drivers/gpu/drm/rockchip/rockchip_drm_vop.c, dw_hdmi-rockchip.c and rockchip_drm_drv.h
validation.hardware: 0012-0014 on the 7.4_rc4 generic sources, built by hand with the 7.4.0-rc4-yume .config and LOCALVERSION -yume-lgtest (same four patched files, byte-identical) and booted on neko-rockpi4c-rk3399 (HDMI-A-1 to an LG ULTRAWIDE). With the custom 216 MHz EDID: vpll and dclk_vop0 216 MHz on vpll from boot, picture without the 297 MHz modeset kick. Without drm.edid_firmware/video=: vpll and dclk_vop0 181.25 MHz, mode 2560x1080 at 59.98 Hz, picture, monitor reports 2560x1080/60Hz (czl). No failed units, no Oops.

r1_changes.0012: Vasily Khoruzhick, 'clk: rockchip: rk3399: add 85.5 MHz rate to PLL rate table' (dri-devel/linux-clk 2026-09-01, 1/2; Reviewed-by Alexey Charkov 2026-10-30; not merged at r1). Carried because 0013 is its series.
r1_changes.0013: Vasily Khoruzhick, 'drm/rockchip: vop: don't round the pixel clock when the encoder owns the PLL' (2/2 of the same series; Chaoyi Chen: approach okay, commit wording and atomic_check vs mode_fixup open; not merged at r1). vop_crtc_mode_fixup() rounded the requested clock on the dclk composite while VPLL still ran at its old rate, so a 216 MHz mode ran at 200 MHz from CPLL (55.6 Hz, LG blank). Replace with whatever lands upstream.
r1_changes.0014: Local: RK3036_PLL_RATE(181250000, 6, 725, 4, 4, 1, 0), 2900 MHz VCO, so the LG ULTRAWIDE's native 2560x1080@59.98 mode passes dw_hdmi_rockchip_mode_valid(). Not sent upstream.
r1_changes.scope: All three change RK3399-only code (CONFIG_CLK_RK3399, CONFIG_DRM_ROCKCHIP). Kernels without those options build the same code as 7.4_rc4; the revision bump renames the release to 7.4.0-rc4-yume-r1 everywhere (czl, 2026-11-25).
